authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/alesis/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/alesis/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter but Mode is a row of the specification's SYSEX AND NRPN PARAMETER CHART (dated 07/12/2001), sent by its MIDI Editing message: F0 00 00 0E 1D 0E, the row's parent page and child ID, then the value, a 17-bit two's complement number in three bytes (<data2> bits 14 - 16, <data1> bits 7 - 13, <data0> bits 0 - 6), F7. Its range and default are the chart's, which prints them as "Sysex Only Fields". Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

<data2> also carries the mix channel (0xxx xyyy: xxxx the channel, yyy the value's top bits). It is sent as 0: in Program mode the A6 ignores it and edits the program edit buffer; in Mix mode the edit goes to mix channel 1, shown on the A6's screen only when that channel is selected. Another mix channel is not laid out.

The chart marks most rows NRPN ON (the parent the NRPN's MSB, the child its LSB), and the A6 sends its panel as NRPNs when Global's PANEL TXMODE says so; the specification prints no NRPN value format (its Default and Range are for SysEx only), so neither sending by NRPN nor following the panel back is laid out.

No Pull: the specification prints the program, mix and global dumps' byte layouts, but in the engine's own values (Oscillator 1 Semitone at bytes 958 - 959, -32768 to +32767, where the chart's OSC_1 TUNESEMITONE is -60 to 60), and does not say how one maps to the other.

The chart names no values (a mod source is 1 to 79), so every chart row is a number. Its names are the firmware's, as printed: the first word the group, the rest the name, POT and SWITCH dropped, underscores as spaces.

Laid out as printed, 14 SWITCH rows the chart gives a range rather than "any": 25 SEQ SYNC_TAB (0 to 1), 111 KBD_MODE UNISONX (0 to 1), 112 KBD_MODE POLYMONO (0 to 1), 451 PRE_FILT FILTERFEEDBACK (0 to 1), 570 POST_FILT FILT1BPINVERT (0 to 1), 571 POST_FILT OSC1SIN_BUTTON (0 to 1), 572 POST_FILT OSC2SIN_BUTTON (0 to 1), 573 POST_FILT RINGMOD_BUTTON (0 to 1), 853 GLOBPG KBD_TAB (0 to 1), 861 GLOBPG PEDAL_TAB (0 to 1), 864 GLOBPG MIDI_TAB (0 to 16), 880 GLOBPG PANEL_TAB (0 to 1), 886 GLOBPG SYSTEM_TAB (0 to 1), 887 GLOBPG VOXMON_TAB (0 to 1).
Left out, rows the chart prints with no default or range: 332 OSC_1 PWMMODDEST POT, 384 OSC_2 PWMMODDEST POT.
Left out, the digital effect's rows whose range "Depends on effect config" (chart indices 975 - 1007: DIGFX OUTPUT_ONE POT - DIGFX PARAM_29 POT): the chart prints no range for any effect.
CLOCK TEMPO POT's range is laid out as printed, 60 to 65335 (index 0); every other row tops out at 65535.
